name: RentCast API
tagline: US property records, rent/value AVMs, listings, and market stats via REST
description: RentCast provides a REST API for nationwide US real estate data: 150M+ property records (attributes, owners, tax and sale history), AVM home value and long-term rent estimates with comparables, active sale/rental listings, and zip-code market statistics. Auth is an API key in the X-Api-Key header; billing is monthly request quotas with per-request overages. A free Developer plan includes 50 requests per month for testing.

auth.details: API key via X-Api-Key header; self-serve signup at app.rentcast.io, create key and activate a plan on the API dashboard. Keys must stay server-side (not in public client code).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Developer plan: 50 API requests/month free; overage $0.20 per additional request
pricing.paid_plans: Foundation $74/mo (1,000 req, $0.06 overage); Growth $199/mo (5,000, $0.03); Scale $449/mo (25,000, $0.015); enterprise on request

rate_limits: 20 requests per second per API key (hard limit; 429 when exceeded), all plans

example.response_snippet: {"rent":1620,"rentRangeLow":1550,"rentRangeHigh":1690,"subjectProperty":{"formattedAddress":"5500 Grand Lake Dr, San Antonio, TX 78244","propertyType":"Single Family","bedrooms":3,"bathrooms":2,"squareFootage":1878},"comparables":[{"formattedAddress":"7306 Kingsland Dr, San Antonio, TX 78244","price":1627,"correlation":0.9873}]}

use_cases: get long-term rent estimate and rental comps for a US address
get home value AVM estimate for a property
look up property record attributes, owner, tax, and sale history by address
search active sale or rental listings in a city or area
fetch zip-code market statistics and historical rent/price trends
